messages.subject: Stan/RStan workshop vids
parts:
Hi folks,

Having received a lot of help from this list, I thought I'd do what little I could to give back by posting some workshop videos I captured back in august that I just got around to uploading: 

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLu77iLvsj_GPoC6tTw01EP1Tcr2I6zEm8

I'm running the workshop again in a couple months, so any feedback is welcome. Certainly I learned that for my frequentist-trained colleagues I need to add content at the beginning on the philosophy of statistics to clarify how frequentists and Bayesians are asking fundamentally different questions. I'll also be working to add posterior predictive checks to all the examples to reinforce that proper practice.

Cheers,

Mike

--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
Department of Psychology & Neuroscience
Dalhousie University

~ Certainty is (possibly) folly ~
